benchmark_detection_model: benchmark the Surya detection model on a PDF file and output precision and recall metrics
benchmark_with_tesseract: benchmark the Surya detection model against Tesseract on a PDF and compare results
benchmark_on_dataset: benchmark the Surya detection model on the detector benchmark dataset with configurable page count
benchmark_with_debug: benchmark the Surya detection model on a PDF and save debug bounding box images
run_detection_benchmark_cli: run the detection benchmark CLI script with custom PDF path and results directory
